description:
Harden the HTTP CRL/OCSP fetcher for production deployment. The cache clock bug (PKIX-f1j4.1) is fixed. Remaining: cache eviction, stale-OCSP overwrite, lock poisoning, async footguns, API hygiene. Existing epic PKIX-cr8 tracks 10 items.

Must-fix for production:
- Cache eviction policy (bounded memory)
- OCSP stale-over-fresh fix
- Lock poisoning policy (propagate or document)
- Async check_revocation_against_anchor default-skip footgun
- now_unix stale-time for long-lived fetchers

Acceptance: pkix-revocation-http passes a multi-hour soak test with rotating CRLs and OCSP responders without memory growth or stale-response bugs.
title: pkix-revocation-http production hardening
